newsitem.title: FINLAND: Cultor to expand lactitol output in U.S.
newsitem.headline: Cultor to expand lactitol output in U.S.

text.p: Finnish food ingredients, bakery and feed group Cultor Oy said on Friday its Xyrofin division would increase output of lactitol at its Thomson plant in the United States to over 10,000 tonnes per year.

"The lactitol production at Cultor's Thomson site is expected to become operational during 1998 and will be capable of producing in excess of 10,000 metric tonnes a year, doubling present world lactitol supply," Cultor said in a statement.
The investment would complete Cultor's 500 million markka investment plan for Xyrofin started in 1994, it said.
Cultor said the $35 million investment in the U.S. will significantly increase Xyrofin's capacity to supply lactitol to the ever-growing low calorie and sugar-free international food markets.

"The additional capacity will also enable Xyrofin to increase its presence in the pharmaceutical market where new opportunities have been identified for lactitol as a highly versatile excipient in both its crystalline and its newly patented directly opressible form," it said.
Lactitol is a bulk sweetener, used primarily in the development of sugar-free and reduced calorie food products such as chocolate, confectionery, baked goods and frozen dairy desserts, Cultor said.
